exact_statement: Let S,W,U,V be independent compatible point indicators on disjoint uniform blocks of positive widths s,L,R,T, and let g be an independent balanced Boolean sign. Set F=1+[WUV OR S(U OR V)](g-1), q=2^-R,r=2^-T,eta=2^-(L+R+T),e=q+r-qr-eta,alpha=2^-s,JB=(L+R+T)eta,JC=R q(1-r)+T r(1-q),JD=JB+JC,pi=eta+alpha e. Query S until failure or completion, then resolve WUV or U OR V and stop at a constant or the actual g. For e<=1/8 every live separator query has B_i/Inf_i<1781/480<4. In particular min(R,T)>=4 gives zero localized strict-K4 bad-control-prefix bill for every s,L. Otherwise define m_*=ceil(log2(min(R,T)+2))+2<=5; in the rare regime define m_*=0. The reserve at live layer j is W_j=2^-j[M_j JD+e M_j(M_j-1)/2+M_j e I(g)], M_j=min(j,m_*), and is zero after separator failure. Its physical drift equals the actual child-product face price c_j=2^-j[JD+(j-1)e+e I(g)] at j<=m_* and zero otherwise. Every possible bad-layer debit is bounded by this drift. With I_sep=s alpha e,I_other=(1-alpha)JB+alpha JC,I_terminal=pi I(g), the entire controller-prefix bad bill obeys Q_bad<=W_s<=5 I_other+2 I_sep+5 I_terminal<=5 I(F), uniformly in all widths and core dimension. Terminal entropy remains pi H(g). Moreover H(F)<=(4+2/ln2)(I_sep+I_other)+W_s+pi H(g); with a separately proved terminal rate C0, H(F)<=max(9+2/ln2,C0+5)I(F). No prescribed-witness funding, arbitrary unbalanced-core K4 bound or general nested-selector reserve is asserted.
